name: io.github.cdrn/sigil
description: Local keystore + MCP server. Claude can sign EVM transactions but never sees the private key.

environmentVariables.name: SIGIL_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Override the default ~/.sigil directory for keyfiles, audit log, and control sockets.

environmentVariables.name: SIGIL_CONTROL_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Override the default control-socket directory (~/.sigil/control/), which holds one <pid>.sock per running sigil-mcp.
